Package com.nexuslink.ui.files

Class PathBookmarks

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.ui.files.PathBookmarks
public final class PathBookmarks extends Object
An ordered, path-unique list of directory bookmarks for a file pane ("favourite" folders the user can jump back to). Pure and JavaFX-free so it is unit-testable; persistence is a trivial tab-separated label\tpath line format, loaded/saved via the static load(java.nio.file.Path)/save(java.nio.file.Path) helpers. Mirrors the pure-helper style of DirectoryDiff and FileOrder.

      public PathBookmarks add(String label, String path)
